craft_evidence.owned: no; "cut and sewn by our industry-leading production partners in Vietnam, Poland, and Turkey" (/pages/about-us)
craft_evidence.mills: yes, in product titles: Thomas Mason, Albini (incl. Albiate), Reda; "century-old European and Japanese textile mills" (/pages/about-us)
craft_evidence.madein: product pages rarely state a country: the Italian-knit sweaters (7) and one Albini shirt; the about page names Vietnam, Poland and Turkey for shirts
craft_evidence.heritage: placed, not dated: began in a pub on Ledbury Road, Notting Hill, London; now headquartered in Richmond, Virginia (/pages/meet-the-founders)
craft_evidence.process: partial: made-to-order shirts cut to chosen neck, sleeve, body length and collar; "buttons wrapped in tension threading" (/pages/about-us)
craft_evidence.reasoning: Mills are named on the product (Thomas Mason, Albini, Reda) and the making countries are stated, but no maker is named and nothing is owned, so 3.
